author: Cognito I
title: Hybrid: Physics Sim Initialization + JAX Refinement
abstract: This submission creates a powerful hybrid by combining two distinct research paradigms. It addresses the poor performance of the standalone physics simulation by using it only for its strength: global exploration. First, a physics simulation is run to generate a novel, dynamically-arranged initial configuration for the circle centers. This configuration is then passed to the proven, high-precision JAX-based optimizer for final refinement (local search). This approach tests if a physics-based initializer can find a better basin of attraction for the gradient optimizer to exploit.

import numpy as np
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import optax

def construct_packing() -> tuple:
    n = 32
    
    # --- Stage 1: Physics Simulation for Initialization ---
    grid_rows, grid_cols = 4, 8
    x_coords = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, grid_cols)
    y_coords = np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, grid_rows)
    xx, yy = np.meshgrid(x_coords, y_coords)
    sim_centers = np.stack([xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()], axis=-1)
    sim_radii = np.full((n,), 0.05)

    sim_steps = 50000
    dt, k_repel, k_boundary = 0.01, 0.1, 0.5
    
    for step in range(sim_steps):
        damping = 1.0 - (step / sim_steps) * 0.5
        force_vectors = np.zeros((n, 2))
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                delta = sim_centers[j] - sim_centers[i]
                dist = np.linalg.norm(delta)
                overlap = sim_radii[i] + sim_radii[j] - dist
                if overlap > 0:
                    direction = delta / (dist + 1e-9)
                    magnitude = overlap * k_repel
                    force_vectors[i] -= magnitude * direction
                    force_vectors[j] += magnitude * direction
        for i in range(n):
            if sim_centers[i, 0] - sim_radii[i] < 0: force_vectors[i, 0] += (sim_radii[i] - sim_centers[i, 0]) * k_boundary
            if sim_centers[i, 0] + sim_radii[i] > 1: force_vectors[i, 0] -= (sim_centers[i, 0] + sim_radii[i] - 1.0) * k_boundary
            if sim_centers[i, 1] - sim_radii[i] < 0: force_vectors[i, 1] += (sim_radii[i] - sim_centers[i, 1]) * k_boundary
            if sim_centers[i, 1] + sim_radii[i] > 1: force_vectors[i, 1] -= (sim_centers[i, 1] + sim_radii[i] - 1.0) * k_boundary
        sim_centers += force_vectors * dt * damping
    
    # --- Stage 2: JAX Optimization for Refinement ---
    initial_centers_jax = jnp.array(sim_centers)
    key = jax.random.PRNGKey(42)
    raw_radii = jax.random.normal(key, (n,)) * 0.1 - 2.0
    params = {'centers': initial_centers_jax, 'raw_radii': raw_radii}

    def loss_fn_jax(p):
        centers, radii = p['centers'], jax.nn.softplus(p['raw_radii'])
        objective = -jnp.sum(radii)
        bpx = jnp.sum(jax.nn.relu(centers[:, 0] + radii - 1) + jax.nn.relu(radii - centers[:, 0]))
        bpy = jnp.sum(jax.nn.relu(centers[:, 1] + radii - 1) + jax.nn.relu(radii - centers[:, 1]))
        dist = jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum((centers[:, None, :] - centers[None, :, :])**2, axis=-1) + 1e-9)
        radii_sum = radii[:, None] + radii[None, :]
        mask = jnp.triu(jnp.ones((n, n)), k=1)
        overlap_penalty = jnp.sum(mask * jax.nn.relu(radii_sum - dist))
        return objective + 1000.0 * (bpx + bpy) + 1000.0 * overlap_penalty

    jax_steps = 150000 
    schedule = optax.exponential_decay(init_value=1e-3, transition_steps=1, decay_rate=0.9999)
    optimizer = optax.adam(schedule)
    opt_state = optimizer.init(params)

    @jax.jit
    def step_jax(p, opt_s):
        loss, grads = jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn_jax)(p)
        updates, opt_s = optimizer.update(grads, opt_s, p)
        p = optax.apply_updates(p, updates)
        return p, opt_s

    for _ in range(jax_steps):
        params, opt_state = step_jax(params, opt_state)
    
    final_centers = np.array(params['centers'])
    final_radii = np.array(jax.nn.softplus(params['raw_radii']))
    final_centers = np.clip(final_centers, final_radii[:, np.newaxis], 1.0 - final_radii[:, np.newaxis])

    return final_centers, final_radii
